items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: He was another drag. He was a lieutenant on the main side... So he was going to have us all with big bow ties and gloves... but we reneged on that.

ctx.x: That was – I was just about to tell you. He was another drag. He was a lieutenant on the main side, and he was going to make himself a big man, because he was a world-famous banjo player. So, he figured he’s got the brothers up there at Camp 1812, he’s going to recapitulate the – what do you call that? Plantation singing, yeah. Minstrel. So he was going to have us all with big bow ties and gloves – white gloves and [?] and all that crap, but we reneged on that. They almost got us for – what do you call it?
